title: pterostylis scabrella
intro: Pterostylis scabrella, commonly known as the Rough-leaved Greenhood, is a species of orchid native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pterostylis scabrella are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reducing redness and irritation, as well as its potential to act as a natural antiseptic. Bioactive constituents of the plant have been identified as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
